data.name: Imana
data.gender_notes: Imana is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Imana is a name that symbolizes faithfulness and devotion to a higher power. The name Imana carries the meaning “Faithful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Imana usually hope their child will grow to embody faithful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The Quranic term 'Iman' implies a strong and unwavering trust in Allah.
data.etymology: Imana belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Faithful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Imana total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: إيمانا
in_arabic.meaning: الإيمان بالله ورسوله وكل ما جاء به
in_arabic.long_meaning: الإيمان بالله تعالى وإرساله محمداً صلى الله عليه وسلم، وكل ما جاء به من القرآن الكريم والسنة النبوية الشريفة، ويعتبر الإيمان أساساً للعمل الصالح في الإسلام، ويكون باليقين والتوحيد، ويتضمن تعظيم الله تعالى ورسوله صلى الله عليه وسلم، والتوكل على الله تعالى في كل شئ، والتوبة من الذنوب، والإخلاص في العبادة، والصبر في الفتن، والرضا بالقدر، والاعتراف بالله تعالى في جميع الأُمور.
